record.paper_title: Properly Coloured Cycles and Paths: Results and Open Problems
record.original_question: Does every c-edge-coloured complete graph K_n^c with maximum monochromatic degree Δ_mon(K_n^c) ≤ floor(n/2) - 1 necessarily contain a properly coloured Hamilton cycle?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 6.6. Every Kc_n with Δmon(Kc_n) ≤ ⌊n/2⌋ − 1 has a PC Hamilton cycle.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $K_n^c$ denote the complete graph on $n$ vertices whose edges are coloured with an arbitrary number of colours $c$ (no restriction on the colouring is imposed; in particular, multiple edges incident to a vertex may share a colour). For a vertex $v$, the monochromatic degree of $v$ is the maximum, over all colours, of the number of edges of that colour incident to $v$. Define
$$\Delta_{\mathrm{mon}}(K_n^c) = \max_{v} \max_{\text{colour } i} \,|\{\text{edges of colour } i \text{ incident to } v\}|.$$
A properly coloured (PC) cycle is a cycle in which no two consecutive edges share a colour, and a PC Hamilton cycle is a properly coloured cycle visiting every vertex of $K_n^c$.

Prove or disprove: every edge-coloured complete graph $K_n^c$ with
$$\Delta_{\mathrm{mon}}(K_n^c) \le \left\lfloor \frac{n}{2} \right\rfloor - 1$$
contains a properly coloured Hamilton cycle.
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture (originating with Bollobás and Erdős, 1976) is known to hold asymptotically: for every ε>0 and sufficiently large n, monochromatic degree below (1/2 − ε)n suffices for a properly coloured Hamilton cycle (Lo, 2016, Combinatorica). The exact bound ⌊n/2⌋ − 1 conjectured remains unresolved as of recent surveys and seminar talks (e.g. Montgomery's BIMSA lecture on the Bollobás–Erdős conjecture).

status_evidence.title: Properly coloured Hamiltonian cycles in edge-coloured complete graphs (Lo)
status_evidence.snippet: For any ε>0, there exists n0 such that every K_n^c with Δ_mon < (1/2−ε)n and n≥n0 contains a properly coloured Hamiltonian cycle; the conjecture of Bollobás and Erdős holds asymptotically.
status_evidence.claim: Conjecture is asymptotically resolved but exact bound remains open.

status_evidence.title: Properly-Coloured Hamilton Cycles and the Bollobás-Erdős Conjecture (Montgomery, BIMSA lecture)
status_evidence.snippet: Lecture discussing the Bollobás-Erdős conjecture on properly-coloured Hamilton cycles, indicating it remains an active open problem.
status_evidence.claim: The exact-bound conjecture is still treated as open in current research talks.
